properties.name: Canyon Overlook Trail — One of Zion's Best Views
properties.title: Canyon Overlook Trail — One of Zion's Best Views
properties.creator: @adventurefamilyvlog
properties.theme: Best short hike / best view in Zion
properties.recommendation_summary: Recommends Canyon Overlook Trail as one of Zion's best views at the end of a 1-mile trail: biggest payoff for least effort in Zion, ~160 ft gain, 1-2 hours, just east of the Zion-Mount Carmel Tunnel, incredible at sunrise or sunset, views over Pine Creek Canyon. This place was already on the map from the @amorywild sunrise reel, so it was added as a second source on that pin instead of a duplicate pin.

properties.name: @adventurefamilyvlog

properties.recommendation_summary: Recommends Canyon Overlook Trail as an epic-view alternative to Angels Landing without the chains, climb or permit: about 1 mile round trip, allow about an hour, just east of the Zion-Mount Carmel Tunnel, with sandstone formations, rock alcoves and exposed sections. Parking is very limited, arrive early. Already on the map from two earlier reels, so added as a third source on that pin.

properties.name: 5 National Park Hikes That Tested My Limit
properties.title: 5 National Park Hikes That Tested My Limit
properties.creator: @amorywild
properties.theme: 5 National Park Hikes That Tested My Limit
properties.recommendation_summary: Ranked #5, an 8-mile round trip with about 4,500 feet of gain, mostly off-trail on the second half. He stopped short of the summit in snow but had views of Lake McDonald. Ranked #4, a 10.5-mile round trip wading the Virgin River in cold water. He went in June during snowmelt and used a dry bib wetsuit. Ranked #3, described as logistically easy but hard because of high, cold water crossings that left him constantly off-balance, wearing wetsuit overalls and layers. Ranked #2, a 17-mile route with about 4,500 feet of gain done in June with snow at the top, which he calls one of the most beautiful hikes he has done despite loose rock. Ranked #1, an 8-mile hike with about 4,500 feet of gain and turquoise lake views. He says he was unprepared on his first attempt and later returned better prepared.
